name: @instatic/plugin-oidc-provider
description: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect Provider — issue ID/access/refresh tokens to third-party applications. Built on @instatic/plugin-public-auth for end-user identity.

instaticManifest.name: OIDC Provider
instaticManifest.description: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider. Supports authorization code flow with PKCE, client credentials, refresh tokens, JWKS, and discovery.

settings.label: Issuer URL
settings.description: The publicly-resolvable issuer URL (e.g. https://auth.example.com). Used in id_token iss claim and discovery document.

settings.label: Require PKCE for all public clients
RSA signing key (PEM, optional)
settings.description: If empty, a new RS256 key pair is generated on first activate and persisted in plugin_secrets.
